title: Cornell Taiwanese Student Association
content_html:
The Cornell Taiwanese Student Association (CTSA; 康乃爾臺灣同學會) is a registered student organization at Cornell University in Ithaca, New York. It is a non-profit, non-religious, and non-political group primarily oriented toward students from Taiwan, helping them navigate life and academics at Cornell.

CTSA’s stated mission centers on supporting Taiwanese students in their academic and personal transition to Cornell, while also serving as a networking platform to build connections among students and between students and the broader Taiwanese community. The organization welcomes anyone with an interest in Taiwanese culture. Documented activities include new student welcome events, a Mid-Autumn Festival barbecue, and seasonal cultural gatherings. The organization also maintains a student handbook to assist incoming Taiwanese students.

CTSA maintains an active web presence through its GitHub-hosted website, an Instagram account (@cornell.tsa), and a Facebook group. It is listed in Cornell’s official CampusGroups directory.
